title: Oscar and the Vector
author: Paloma Yarrow
blurb: Kestrel Hartwell, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
